description: Introduces hostile and neutral boss fleets in unexplored star systems. Includes restored Plague-bearer ships from Seeker and four custom boss ships with unique escorts. Provides interesting salvage opportunities for players exploring the frontier.

discordPostHtml:
Adds a collection of boss fleets to unexplored systems, with some neutral to the player, but most actively hostile.

What this mod contains:

  • Restored versions of 2 Plague-bearer boss ships from Seeker (you can recover them the legit way).
  • 4 custom boss ships with up to 9 unique escort ships to be recovered.
  • Some interesting salvage to be found floating about.

WARNING: Not save compatible. Adding this mod to an ongoing save won't break anything, but it might either spawn nothing or not spawn all the intended content.

**Credits: **

Tartiflette for making Seeker - Unidentified Contact, thanks to which I was able to get this whole thing started (the base sprites for 2 of my bosses and much of the .jar scripts came from his work, really)
Xarra for providing two of my ships with some neat plating segments and bays, as well as Emto Demto for letting me use his circular mini phase coil design
Kirbo / Vexlia / Yendork / Noof / Quacken / a few others I might unfortunately be forgetting for their continued help and advice while spriting (and a bit with coding too)

changelog.1.5.0:
Tweaked and more or less reworked most of the phase ships. Includes better mount types for more loadout variety, stat adjustments and updated sprites for the rougher looking ones.
Modified the Undine line's campaign level encounter to include a new surprise and reshuffled their names to better fit the overall naming scheme. Also, most of them can now swap their built-ins between different projectile types!
Revised some weapon descriptions.
Added one more tag to the built-in weapons to make sure they wouldn't drop under any circumstances.
Changed the scavenger fleet guarding the derelict Pangea's ship graveyard to be hostile to the player (felt a bit strange to just let you plunder their rightful loot like that).
Nerfed the Ardent as it felt too powerful (removed/reduced the size of quite a few mounts, adjusted the op and dp accordingly). Still a tough ship, just more reasonably so.
Replaced the possibility for mercenary escort fleets to use particular modded ships as flagships with a Fury instead (didn't make much sense for them to have access to those ships anyway).
Raised the Agony's dp from 60 to 80 and split the reality warper into two weapons that you can swap between on the refit screen (the reality warper that now does energy damage exclusively and a disruptor version with a matching cooldown).
changelog.1.3.0:
Reality Warper: Substentially reduced the EMP damage (1800 -> 800), nerfed range (1500 -> 1200).
Shock Cannon: Reduced the range (1000 -> 800) and EMP damage (1000 -> 500).
Phased Particle Blaster: Reduced damage (1200 -> 1000).
Phase Particle Streamer: Reduced the range (1000 -> 600).
Fixed and renamed the loadout of the Unease.
Tweaked a few stats of the Naiad (250 -> 300 armor, raised min and max crew).
Added one final boss ship and a frigate support.
Modified some Plague-bearer encounters to make some roam a bit and others a bit more hostile.
changelog.1.2.3:
Slightly nerfed the dp of most ships to better reflect their overall capabilities
Buffed op count for the Nereid (90 -> 100) and the Misery (115 -> 130)
